name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.74.0: backend theme step 1 — palette, type and square corners, as public/theme-accent.css loaded after the inline style. This is the SAFE SUBSET of the handed-over agvending-backend.css: tokens, the aliases pointing the old cream/bronze names at the new values, the typeface, and a forced border-radius reset. Previewed first against the real dashboard through a proxy, which is how two problems were found. The full file cannot be dropped in: six of its selectors collide with classes this dashboard already uses heavily (.btn on 149 elements, .field 111, .panel 84, .mono 53, .stat 37, .page 19) and the collision takes the fleet page apart — tabs, KPI tiles, search and the machine table all vanish into whitespace, because .page here is the routed page container and there it is a centred flex column. Its other 49 classes (.row .stats .status .nav .site-header .list) match no markup at all. Those sections wait for a markup migration. Second, the original alias block remaps colour variables but not the three font variables the dashboard actually sets font-family from, so Cormorant Garamond survived every heading and KPI number; --serif, --sans and --mono are aliased here too. border-radius:0 needs !important because the dashboard sets an explicit radius on 109 class rules and a class selector outranks the universal one. Verified in a browser on the branch: Libre Franklin applied, 263 sampled elements all square, app shell and all 18 nav items present, no horizontal scroll, no page errors, no failed assets. Reverting this commit restores the previous look exactly. Cumulative over v6.73.10.
